record.question: A patient has painless purulent exudate, along with nausea, vomiting and dizziness, the nurse suspects the following condition:
record.explanation: Answer A: Chronic otitis media. Chronic suppurative otitis media can cause painless, persistent purulent ear discharge; otorrhea names the symptom, while the stem asks for the underlying condition. Source/context note: Dizziness may indicate complications or another vestibular condition and needs clinical assessment. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK470332/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
